statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-76844 is a path traversal in getFilenameFromUrl in webpack-dev-middleware, a Node.js package published on npm, fixed in webpack-dev-middleware 7.4.6 and 8.3.0: https://github.com/webpack/webpack-dev-middleware/security/advisories/GHSA-g84c-rxfj-3j2c. It is not a zlib vulnerability. The Debian security tracker marks it NOT-FOR-US (webpack-dev-middleware) and lists no Debian source package for it: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-76844. Debian's generated OSV record DEBIAN-CVE-2026-76844 nevertheless lists the zlib source with 1:1.3.dfsg+really1.3.1-1+deb13u1 as the trixie fixed version; that version is the zlib security update DSA-6613-1, which addresses CVE-2026-27171 and CVE-2026-85091 only: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/DSA-6613-1. Unpacked all 32 binary packages published from the zlib source in the DHI Debian repository, each checked against the index SHA256: two builds of zlib 1.3.1, one made from Debian's 1:1.3.dfsg+really1.3.1-1 source and one from its 1:1.3.dfsg+really1.3.1-1+deb13u1 source, for amd64 and arm64, namely zlib1g, zlib1g-dev, libminizip1t64, libminizip-dev and minizip, and the debug-symbol packages zlib1g-dbgsym, libminizip1t64-dbgsym and minizip-dbgsym. They hold the zlib and minizip C libraries (libz.so.1.3.1, libminizip.so.1.0.0), the minizip and miniunzip programs, the static archives libz.a and libminizip.a containing zlib's and minizip's own object files, C headers, pkg-config files, documentation, C example sources and detached debug information. No package contains a JavaScript file, a node_modules directory, npm package metadata or any other part of webpack-dev-middleware.
